english.title: Controller / manager of residential accommodation required to be licensed under Part 3 of the Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had control of or managed a house at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..) which was required to be licensed under Part 3 of the Housing Act 2004 but was not so licensed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 95(1) and (5) of the Housing Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having control of / managing a house
required to be licensed under Pt 3
but was not so licensed.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 95(1), it is a defence that, at the material time -
(a) a notification had been duly given in respect of the house under section 62(1) or 86(1), or
(b) an application for a licence had been duly made in respect of the house under section 87
and that notification or application was still effective(ii) In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 95(1), it is a defence that he had a reasonable excuse for having control of or managing the house in the circumstances mentioned
(iii) For an offence committed on or after the 1st May 2026, see H102710 and H102711.
